Hello Siddharth Ranade (S2026CS012), you currently have two overdue fee items. Please find the details of your outstanding balances and applicable late fines below:

| Component | Outstanding Balance | Late Fine | Due Date |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| tuition_inst1 | ₹45,000 | ₹5,000 | 14 Aug 2026 |
| exam | ₹3,500 | ₹500 | 31 Oct 2026 |

**Supporting Details:**
*   **Late Fines:** Per policy, tuition instalments incur a daily fine of ₹100 capped at ₹5,000 per component [Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §4]. Your tuition fine has reached this cap [SQL]. The examination fee incurs a flat fine of ₹500 [Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §4].
*   **Total Outstanding:** The total outstanding balance is ₹45,000 + ₹3,500 = ₹48,500 [SQL].
*   **Payment:** These items are marked as overdue because a balance remains after the due date [Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §3]. You may pay these online through the student portal [Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §3].
*   **Waivers:** The Accounts Office may waive late fines only for documented medical emergencies or bereavement, provided an application is submitted within 30 days [Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §4].
sql: SELECT component, amount_due, amount_paid, (amount_due - amount_paid) AS outstanding_balance, due_date, CASE WHEN component = 'exam' THEN 500 ELSE LEAST((CAST('2026-11-23' AS DATE) - due_date) * 100, 5000) END AS late_fine FROM (SELECT * FROM fee_ledger WHERE student_id = 'S2026CS012') AS fee_ledger WHERE student_id = 'S2026CS012' AND status = 'overdue' ORDER BY due_date ASC LIMIT 200
